name: Jakin
title: Son of Simeon and high priest
summary: Jakin is a biblical figure mentioned in several contexts. He was the son of Simeon, Jacob's son, and thus a head of one of the tribes of Israel. The name Jakin also appears among the priestly families who served in the temple during David's time, where the 21st priestly division bore his name.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a son of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Jakin is listed as one of the sons of Simeon in the genealogy when Jacob's family went to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Simeon in the Book of Numbers
keyEvents.description: Jakin's lineage is mentioned among the descendants of Simeon who formed the clan of the Jachinites in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Sons of Simeon in the Book of Exodus
keyEvents.description: Jakin is counted among the sons of Simeon in the list of Jacob's sons who came to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of Simeon in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jakin is mentioned again in Simeon's family tree within the detailed genealogies of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The 21st Priestly Division
keyEvents.description: A man named Jakin was chosen as head of the 21st priestly division that served in the temple during David's organization of the priesthood.

keyEvents.title: Priests settled in Jerusalem after the exile
keyEvents.description: A priest named Jakin is mentioned among those who settled in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile.
